title: When do biased walks help?
question: Which graph structures make node2vec's walk bias useful?
data: Synthetic stochastic block models and Cora
baselines: DeepWalk, node2vec, degree features plus logistic regression
evaluation: Node macro-F1 and accuracy; sweep homophily, walk length, p and q under fixed embedding budgets.
extension: Relate performance to mixing time and community strength.

title: PageRank as a learning prior
question: Can personalized diffusion improve classification when labels are scarce?
baselines: MLP, GCN, personalized PageRank propagation
evaluation: Accuracy versus labeled fraction; fix splits and compare propagation depth and damping.
extension: Choose damping using local graph structure without test labels.

title: Attention under noisy edges
question: Does learned graph attention remain useful as irrelevant edges increase?
data: Cora plus controlled random edge additions
baselines: GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT
evaluation: Accuracy and calibration versus edge corruption; match parameter counts and tuning budgets.
extension: Compare attention entropy with robustness and test a sparsity regularizer.

title: Learning across unlike neighbors
question: When do neighborhood aggregation models fail on heterophilous graphs?
baselines: MLP, GCN, GAT and a heterophily-aware model
evaluation: Dataset-appropriate accuracy or ROC-AUC; preserve supplied splits and report multiple seeds.
extension: Adapt the balance of self features and neighbor features.

title: How deep can a GNN go?
question: Which changes preserve predictive information as network depth increases?
baselines: Plain GCN, residual GCN and normalization variants
evaluation: Accuracy, embedding similarity and Dirichlet energy across depth; control training budget.
extension: Separate optimization failure from oversmoothing with controlled interventions.

title: Rewiring graph bottlenecks
question: Can a few added edges improve long-range information transfer?
data: Synthetic trees, barbell graphs and distance-label tasks
baselines: GCN or MPNN with no rewiring, random rewiring and a topology-aware rule
evaluation: Long-range task accuracy, path length and runtime at equal edge budgets.
extension: Study the trade-off between shortcut benefits and structural distortion.

title: A fair transformer comparison
question: When does global attention earn its extra compute?
baselines: GIN, a graph transformer and a local/global hybrid
evaluation: Regression MAE, peak memory and runtime; match parameters and training budget.
extension: Identify graph sizes or structures where global attention helps.
compute: Small GPU; use a declared subset for pilots

title: Which positional encoding matters?
question: How stable are graph transformers to positional encoding choices?
baselines: Transformer without positional encoding, Laplacian encoding and random-walk encoding
evaluation: MAE and permutation consistency; vary signs, eigenspaces and graph size.
extension: Test sign-invariant or noise-robust encoding variants.

title: Self-supervision with few labels
question: Which graph augmentations help when supervision is limited?
baselines: Supervised GCN, DGI and a contrastive graph encoder
evaluation: Linear-probe accuracy across label budgets; tune augmentations on validation data only.
extension: Replace uniform edge dropping with a structure-aware rule.

title: Masked graph reconstruction
question: Can reconstructing masked features improve robustness to missing attributes?
baselines: MLP, GCN and GraphMAE-style pretraining
evaluation: Classification accuracy and reconstruction loss across random and structured missingness.
extension: Compare degree-aware masking with uniform masking.

title: Predicting future collaborations
question: How much do graph embeddings improve over simple link heuristics?
baselines: Common neighbors, Adamic–Adar, node2vec and GraphSAGE
evaluation: Official Hits@50 with official temporal splits and negative candidates; document allowed edges.
extension: Add recency-aware edge weights and audit temporal leakage.
compute: Moderate GPU; prototype on a declared subset

title: Learning from event streams
question: When does temporal memory beat a static graph encoder?
data: Wikipedia temporal interaction data distributed with TGN
baselines: Static GraphSAGE, a recency heuristic and TGN
evaluation: Average precision and ROC-AUC with time-ordered splits and explicit negative sampling.
extension: Test memory resets, time encodings and unseen-node performance.

title: Relations in a knowledge graph
question: Do relation-aware messages improve completion beyond embedding models?
baselines: DistMult, TransE and R-GCN with a common scoring head where appropriate
evaluation: Filtered MRR and Hits@10; prevent inverse-relation leakage and report relation-wise errors.
extension: Allocate relation parameters by frequency or sparsity.

title: Graph recommendations beyond popularity
question: Can graph propagation improve recommendation for low-activity users?
baselines: Popularity, matrix factorization and LightGCN
evaluation: Recall@20 and NDCG@20 on a time-ordered split; keep candidate sampling fixed.
extension: Analyze accuracy and coverage across user-activity groups without inferring sensitive attributes.

title: Molecular learning under distribution shift
question: Do stronger graph encoders generalize to new molecular scaffolds?
baselines: Fingerprint classifier, GCN and GIN
evaluation: Official ROC-AUC on scaffold splits; add calibration and performance by scaffold frequency.
extension: Compare pretraining or edge-feature treatments under equal tuning budgets.

title: Generating diverse small graphs
question: Which generative model best preserves structure without memorization?
baselines: Erdos–Renyi or block-model generator, GraphRNN and a small graph GAN
evaluation: Validity, uniqueness, novelty, and degree/clustering distribution distances on held-out graphs.
extension: Diagnose mode collapse as graph size and training diversity change.

title: Adversarial versus diffusion generation
question: How do adversarial and diffusion objectives trade quality for cost?
data: Small synthetic graphs; optional QM9 extension
baselines: A MolGAN-inspired discrete generator and a small DiGress-style model
evaluation: Validity, diversity, novelty, structural fidelity and training/sample time at matched graph sizes.
extension: If using molecules, add chemical-validity checks and compare conditional generation.

title: Are graph explanations stable?
question: Does a model explanation persist across seeds and harmless perturbations?
data: Synthetic motif graphs with known generating motifs
baselines: Gradient saliency, random edge masks and GNNExplainer
evaluation: Fidelity, sparsity, motif precision/recall and agreement across repeated runs.
extension: Build a stability-aware explanation selection rule; distinguish explanation from causality.

title: Robustness on a fixed edge budget
question: Which defenses withstand targeted structural perturbations?
data: Cora or CiteSeer public benchmark graphs
baselines: GCN, GAT, edge-drop training and a simple graph denoiser
evaluation: Clean and perturbed accuracy across equal budgets; distinguish random from targeted perturbations.
extension: Test whether defense gains persist on unseen perturbation strategies in an offline benchmark.

title: Do benchmark rankings survive protocol changes?
question: How sensitive are model rankings to splits, tuning and random seeds?
data: Cora plus ogbn-arxiv, with a smaller scoped pilot if needed
baselines: MLP, GCN, GraphSAGE and GAT
evaluation: Accuracy distributions, rank stability, runtime and tuning cost; preserve official test protocols.
extension: Measure how small search budgets alter conclusions and publish a reproducibility checklist.
